reasoning: On the season so far the Suns are the stronger team; with home court the Suns start about 7 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Suns.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Kings (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Suns win 70 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.
